# Papercusp

> Internal engineering documentation for Papercusp - a local-first multi-agent coding harness.

## Documentation Sets

- [Abridged documentation](http://localhost:3070/internal/docs/llms-small.txt): a compact version of the documentation for Papercusp, with non-essential content removed
- [Complete documentation](http://localhost:3070/internal/docs/llms-full.txt): the full documentation for Papercusp

## Notes

- The complete documentation includes all content from the official documentation
- The content is automatically generated from the same source as the official documentation
